children.name:
AssertionError: Three horizontal lines (menu icon) not visible in Body Composition section
assert False
 +  where False = is_visible("//h2[normalize-space()='Body Composition']/following-sibling::div//button[i[contains(@class,'fa-bars')]]")
 +    where is_visible = <pages.userFacingPages.body_composition_page.BodyCompositionPage object at 0x7f8614c97d40>.is_visible
 +      where <pages.userFacingPages.body_composition_page.BodyCompositionPage object at 0x7f8614c97d40> = <test_body_composition.TestBodyComposition object at 0x7f8614d44c80>.body_composition
 +    and   "//h2[normalize-space()='Body Composition']/following-sibling::div//button[i[contains(@class,'fa-bars')]]" = BodyCompositionPage.BODY_COMPOSITION_MENU_ICON
